title: Boundary sheaf of an open immersion
statement:
Let $X$ be of finite type over $k$, let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an
open immersion, let
$i:Z=X\setminus U\hookrightarrow X$ be its closed complement, and let
$F$ be a constructible
$\Lambda$-sheaf on $U_{{\mathrm{et}}}$. Then the boundary sheaf
$i^*j_*F$, with the inverse image of
[def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], is constructible on $Z_{{\mathrm{et}}}$.

proof.text: By [thm-fin-open-degree-zero], applied to the finite-type $k$-scheme $X$, the open immersion $j$ and the constructible module sheaf $F$ over the finite commutative ring $\Lambda$, the direct image $j_*F$ is constructible on $X$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]: there is a finite stratification of $X$ by locally closed constructible subschemes on whose strata the inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. Forgetting that the strata are constructible subsets, this says that $j_*F$ is constructible in the sense of [def-constructible-constructible], with values in $\Lambda$-modules. Apply [prop-constructible-pullback] to the closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$: $i^*(j_*F)$, with the same inverse image functor on module sheaves, is constructible in the sense of [def-constructible-constructible], i.e. $Z$ has a finite stratification by locally closed subschemes on each of which the pullback of $i^*j_*F$ is finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules. It remains to see that these strata are constructible subsets of $Z$, as [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] requires. The scheme $X$ is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], since a field is Noetherian, so every nonempty set of closed subsets of $X$ has a minimal element by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal]. Closed subsets of the closed subset $Z$ are closed in $X$, so the same holds in $Z$, whose underlying space is therefore Noetherian. In a Noetherian space every locally closed subset is constructible ([def-weil-constructible-subset], Stacks Lemma 005L). Hence the stratification of $Z$ consists of locally closed constructible subschemes with finite locally constant restrictions, and $i^*j_*F$ is constructible on $Z_{\mathrm{et}}$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].

split_report.summary: Audited the imported one-paragraph proof against the current blueprint and the cited DAG statements. Replaced the unsupported assertion that inverse image preserves finite constant trivializations by the existing general pullback-constructibility result prop-constructible-pullback, while retaining the open direct-image theorem and the inverse-image/constructibility definitions. No new node was needed. Maintainer reader (FIX): the step now also checks that the pulled-back strata are constructible subsets of Z (Z is Noetherian), since prop-constructible-pullback concludes constructibility only in the sense of def-constructible-constructible, which does not require constructible strata.
split_report.blueprint: The single proof step realizes the whole proof paragraph: first constructibility of j_*F by thm-fin-open-degree-zero, then pullback along i by prop-constructible-pullback.

tool_uses.why: The boundary argument needs the generic theorem that inverse image along any scheme morphism preserves constructibility; the affine-line/Kummer unit supplies no such general sheaf lemma.
